Nashama TV Windows Update v1.3.2:
- Fixed the +10s / -10s buttons (and the arrow keys) sending an episode back to the start on some series, including the latest episodes of المنظمة.
- Seeking now works on videos from servers that don't support jumping, instead of restarting the episode.
- If playback hits an error, it now resumes from where you were instead of restarting from the beginning.
